bug.description: An existing feature does not behave as documented or expected.
bug.label: bug

enhancement.description: A request for a new feature or improvement.
enhancement.label: enhancement

question.description: A usage or troubleshooting question without clear evidence of a defect.
question.label: question

other.description: None of the other categories, or insufficient evidence.

frontend.description: Browser UI, layout, accessibility or client interactions.

unknown.description: Insufficient evidence or no matching module.
